source.note: Official league gallery of the 2026-27 kits. Its photo captioned 'Al Faisaly Home + Away 26-27' (https://images.spl.com.sa/image/private/t_w_1920-f_webp-c_scale/v1786633600/prd/ohx1zwsxgj3yr4tpsajp) shows ALDREES as the large centre-chest sponsor on the maroon home shirt. No named press article for the kit launch was found; the club announced the adidas kits on X/Instagram, which scripts cannot open.

source.note: Official league gallery of the 2026-27 kits. Its 'Al Faisaly Home + Away 26-27' photo (https://images.spl.com.sa/image/private/t_w_1920-f_webp-c_scale/v1786633600/prd/ohx1zwsxgj3yr4tpsajp) shows the Tameeni (تأميني) logo in a light-blue patch on the chest, next to the adidas maker's mark, above the Aldrees logo.

source.name: Saudi Pro League – Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL
source.note: Kit maker. The gallery's 'Al Faisaly Home + Away 26-27' photo (https://images.spl.com.sa/image/private/t_w_1920-f_webp-c_scale/v1786633600/prd/ohx1zwsxgj3yr4tpsajp) shows the adidas maker's logo and three stripes on both the maroon home and white away shirts. adidas has made Al Faisaly's kits since 2018 (nine seasons, per fan account @mnbr_alfaisaly on X, unsourced here).

summary: Adidas home kit with Aldrees across the chest and Tameeni in a chest patch. Front placements are taken from the league's official 2026-27 kit-gallery photo; the back, sleeves and shorts could not be checked from any available source, so the sponsor list is not complete. The club's website lists four further partners (Aldrees, Roco, Tameeni, Berain; a September 2026 matchday poster adds Mando), but their shirt placements, if any, are unverified.
